summary: HomelabTerraformProvider phase/022-P1 (c1badcb) adds homelab_s3_reader (RGW user, max_buckets -1, cap buckets=read) and an opt-in grant_backup_reader on homelab_s3_storage that writes a list+get bucket policy naming the provider's s3_backup_reader / HOMELAB_S3_BACKUP_READER, signed with the owner's key; removed policies refresh as drift, dropping the ask revokes. Protocol-server tests show no ask plans no change and a no-reader provider makes no policy request and plans only the ask; kc project test green, acceptance tests unrun (operator, logged in close-out).
